name: しおり
tagline: Turns yesterday's X bookmarks into a short morning briefing
description: Bookmarks pile up far faster than anyone reads them. Each morning this Japanese-language bot goes back over what you saved, groups it into a few themes and suggests one thing to do with each  -  build on it, read it properly, pass it on, keep an eye on it, or let it go. It never posts or likes from your account.
author: まるいも
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
